name: SelfNeRF
definition: SelfNeRF is a novel view synthesis method for human performance that trains from scratch using monocular self-rotating video inputs, achieving high-fidelity results in approximately twenty minutes by using a surface-relative hash encoding to aggregate inter-frame information.
summary: SelfNeRF is a novel view synthesis method that trains high-fidelity human NeRF models from monocular self-rotating video using surface-relative hash encoding, eliminating the need for multi-view inputs or skeletal priors.
